meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you a question. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Take the zero off his record, Hale. Then answer my question about whether Owen was heard first.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? Teams don't hand out zeros without a phone call. What do you actually have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed in today's meeting. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because no ownership of the process and no dated document tied to Owen's work was offered.
What cost ground: the praise of her lawyering and the same-team appeal cost the most, because she read both as attempts to manage her instead of answering who decided and on what basis.
Try next time: when she first asked who decided and whether anyone called her, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you contacted her, then show her a dated document she can check herself.
